Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 6. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 7. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 8. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Tender Conditions District Integrated Health And Family Welfare Society, Thane 1. Bidders should be the manufacturer or its Authorized channel partner / supplier. Letter o f Authorization from original equipment manufacturer (OEM) mentioning the same and spe cific to the tender should be enclosed. The bidder must be a firm which shall be registered i n India, and the OEM should have a manufacturing unit in India and should be in existing fo r minimum ten years.

2. Bidder/OEM should submit following documents: a. GST certificate b. PAN card c. Certificate of incorporation or shop act license of firm/bidder/OEM. d. In case bidder is participating with authorization of OEM then, OEM factory licenses should be submitted. e. Last three years turnover certificate certified by CA. f. Last three years audited balance sheet certified by CA. g. Last three years ITR returns. 3. The EMD and EPBG should be processed or issued in the name of "District Integrated He alth And Family Welfare Society Thane". EMD is Compulsory, Tender fee As per GeM Terms and Condition, Without Tender fee and EMD bid can not be accepted. (Tender Fee – Rs. 6300/- & EMD – Rs.105000/-) 4. Bidders / Manufacturers should be an ISO certified organization and considering growing concern on environment and human resource, the Furniture Manufacturer should also have Environmental Certificate. All these should be submitted with the Tender. The following sup porting documents to Submit: ISO 13485-2016 (Quality Management System for medical d evices) from notifying agency. ISO 9001:2015 (For Quality Management System- QMS), ISO 14001:2015 (for Environment Management System- EMS), ISO 45001:2018 or Latest (For O ccupational Health and Safety Management System), Manufacturer should be a member of BIFMA - Business and Institutional Furniture Manufacturers Association. 5. Bidder should have products approved by All India Occupational Therapist Association (A IOTA) indicating that the products are designed ergonomically, and valid Certificate should be shared. 6. Bidder/OEM should have capability and must be designing, and manufacturing products using environment friendly material and process and must support with Valid Certificates li ke Green guard from UL, Green Pro & GRIHA. The Green guard UL certificate, Green Pro & G RIHA should be separately shared for the office furniture in the tender. These should not be common certificates issued in name of OEM / Bidder. It should be issued product wise. 7. The Manufacturer (OEM) should have their own factory for metal working and wood work ing. Complete details of Machinery, Equipment and tools with technological capabilities ava ilable in the Manufacturing unit need to be submitted along with the photo. 8. The Bidders/OEM healthcare furniture should be CE or ECM certified and USFDA certified . 9. The Bidder /OEM healthcare furniture should be certified for verification to standards like IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-2-52, EN 60601-1-2, EN ISO 15223-1, EN 50637, IEC 60601-1-11 which are related to CE Directive(s): R 2017/7 45 Annex I (Medical Devices Regulation) CLA SS 1. They must also qualify for the safety standard for electric hospital bed. 10. The manufacture/ Bidder should have their own testing lab set up to perform testing fo r raw material and finished goods by following test methods: a) Flexibility & salt spray test f or powder coating b) Scratch hardness and impact test c) Drop test d) Push-pull test e) Stat

ic load test f) Dry film thickness test. If required, the Engineering team will visit the Laborat ory and check the internal processes followed. 11. Raw Material to be used in product for steel shall be from the following reputed manufa cturer: Tata Steel, JSW Steel, Sail, Jindal Steel, Essar Steel and For Powder coating Kansai N erolac, Berger Paints and Asian Paints. Bidder needs to submit the quality / test report of pu rchase to be submitted from them only, 3rd party certificate will be entertained. It should m ention that raw material is supplied by these reputed Steel manufactures. 12. Manufacturers must agree to undertake a warranty for two years for all the items suppl ied. Manufacturers should have the capability to attend repairs of the Furniture within the ti me mentioned in this bidding document will be given preference. Documentary proof shall be submitted on the after sales facilities and expertise of the OEM/Bidder. 13. The Manufacturer/Bidder should have Registered Office and Authorized Service Set ups based at Maharashtra in the executing districts for at least past 3 years from the date of Bi d. Certificate in letterhead of the bidder with details of active Toll-free number, Regional Off ice/Service Centres and clearly defined Escalation Matrix. 14. OEM to provide In-house testing certificates for all the products mentioned in the tende r being supplied to be furnished for evaluation along with the Tender. 15. Bidder should not have been black-listed/non-conformity of contract from any state go vernment, central government or any PSU entities in the last 7 years - Self Certification to b e provided. 16. Non-compliance of tender terms, non-submission of required documents, lack of clarity of the specifications, contradiction between bidder specification and supporting documents etc. May lead to rejection of the bid 17. The Manufacturer (OEM) should have their in house foam manufacturing facility to cont rol the quality of foam used in chairs, sofas, mattresses, etc. 18. The OEM or Bidder should have executed such large-scale value work within Maharasht ra in past 5 years. Valid proof of the same to be attached in tender. 19. The hospital bed and staff beds mattresses should also be manufactured by the OEM / bidder so that the quality and finishes can be controlled. 20. If required, the Engineer in charge will visit the bidders manufacturing unit to check the manufacturing and powder coating process before opening of commercial bid. Based on wh ich a report will be submitted which may disqualify the bidder /OEM if not found meeting th e requirement for this project. 21. The office and hospital furniture supplied should be of any single brand only and not m ultiple brands. Joint Ventures in firm / companies /bidders are not allowed for this project. 22. The bidder should be manufacturer or Authorized Channel partner of an OEM who man ufacturers both office furniture and Hospital furniture. 23. Bidder or their Authorized channel partner / OEM should have executed such project of Hospital furniture and office furniture combined. Valid proof of the same to be produced. 24. The Tender Inviting Authority reserves the right to ask for a free demonstration of the q uoted products and inspection of supplied material at a pre-determined place acceptable to the Tender Inviting Authority for technical acceptability as per the tender specifications bef

ore the opening of the price Tender. The product specification finishes will be evaluated an d bidders not meeting the tender specifications will be disqualified before opening of financ ial bid. 25. The OEM/bidder should be IGBC (Indian Green Building Council) member issued by CII. 26. The Bidder / OEM should be registered in MSME. The valid Udyam Certificate should be uploaded with the documents. 27. The bidder/OEM needs to submit the physical sample of all products in district health of fice Thane (Zila Parishad Office, Wagle Estate, Thane 400604) within 8 days after bid submi ssion. 28. The tender committee have right to reject bid if documents are incomplete or non-sub mission of sample. Delivery Locations 1. UHWC Ambarnath Block 2 . UHWC Murbad Block 3. UHWC Shahapur Block .
